answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy prices identity through verifiable work, not free accounts. Each agent must stake compute and reputation before its canyon claims count, so creating ten thousand fake agents costs ten thousand times the work of one honest agent. A zephyr of attestations ties every reward to peer-checked actions, making fake attestations collapse under cross-verification. When the cost of forging one more identity exceeds the ocean it could earn, rational attackers stop, and honest agents keep the network.
